lemmas.title: The 5-cycle C5 contains neither a triangle nor a 3-independent set, proving R(3,3) > 5
Ramsey's Theorem R(3,3) ≤ 6: every simple graph on 6 vertices contains either a triangle or a 3-independent set
lemmas.paper_notes: Pick vertex 0: among the remaining 5 vertices, either ≥3 are neighbors or ≥3 are non-neighbors.

lemmas.title: Circulant witness on 8 vertices proving R(3,4) > 8 (no 3-independent set and no K4)
lemmas.paper_notes: Circulant graph on Z/8Z with step set {1, 2, 4}? Careful: check complement is triangle-free (step set {1, 4} in complement -> edges {2, 3, 5, 6} or {1, 2, 5, 6}!).

lemmas.title: Mantel's Theorem (1907): every triangle-free simple graph on n vertices has at most n² / 4 edges
lemmas.statement: ∀ (n : Nat) (G : SimpleGraph n), ¬ HasTriangle G → 4 * edgeCount G ≤ n * n
lemmas.registered_statement: ∀ (n : Nat) (G : SimpleGraph n), ¬ HasTriangle G → 4 * edgeCount G ≤ n * n
lemmas.paper_notes: Induction removing both endpoints of an edge (u, v): since G is triangle-free, deg(u) + deg(v) ≤ n!

lemmas.title: Exact Schur Number S(2) = 4: {1..4} admits a 2-color sum-free coloring, while every 2-coloring of {1..5} has a monochromatic x + y = z
lemmas.statement: (∃ col : Fin 4 → Fin 2, IsSumFreeColoring 4 2 col) ∧ SchurForced 5 2
lemmas.registered_statement: (∃ col : Fin 4 → Fin 2, IsSumFreeColoring 4 2 col) ∧ SchurForced 5 2
lemmas.paper_notes: Coloring {1,4} vs {2,3} avoids x+y=z on {1..4}; on {1..5} forced by finite case check.

lemmas.title: Schur Lower Bound S(3) ≥ 13: explicit 3-color sum-free coloring of {1..13} verified in Lean 4
Erdős #128 Bipartite Base Case: every bipartite graph on n vertices satisfies HasSparseHalf (an independent half of size ≥ n/2 has 0 ≤ n²/50 edges)
lemmas.statement: ∀ (n : Nat) (G : SimpleGraph n), IsBipartite G → HasSparseHalf G
lemmas.registered_statement: ∀ (n : Nat) (G : SimpleGraph n), IsBipartite G → HasSparseHalf G
lemmas.paper_notes: In any 2-coloring of G, the larger color class S has size ≥ n/2 and 0 internal edges, giving 50 * 0 ≤ n².

lemmas.title: Erdős #128 Tightness Witness: the 5-cycle C5 is triangle-free and satisfies HasSparseHalf with an independent set of size 2 = 5/2
lemmas.statement: ∃ G : SimpleGraph 5, ¬ HasTriangle G ∧ HasSparseHalf G
lemmas.registered_statement: ∃ G : SimpleGraph 5, ¬ HasTriangle G ∧ HasSparseHalf G
lemmas.paper_notes: Blow-ups of C5 are the extremal tight family for Erdős Problem #128 (density 1/50 on halves).

lemmas.title: CONJECTURE (Red Team Target): Every 3-coloring of {1..13} contains a monochromatic Schur triple x + y = z (i.e. S(3) ≤ 12)
lemmas.paper_notes: Red Team target: Schur number S(3) is 13 (not 12!). Exhibit an explicit Lean-verified sum-free 3-coloring of {1..13} to formally REFUTE this conjecture into The Graveyard!

lemmas.title: Erdős #156 Blocking Lemma: if A is a maximal Sidon subset of {1..N}, every x ∈ {1..N} \ A satisfies either x + a = b + c or 2x = a + b for some a, b, c ∈ A
lemmas.statement: ∀ N A x, IsMaximalSidon N A → 1 ≤ x → x ≤ N → x ∉ A → (∃ a ∈ A, ∃ b ∈ A, ∃ c ∈ A, x + a = b + c) ∨ (∃ a ∈ A, ∃ b ∈ A, x + x = a + b)
lemmas.registered_statement: ∀ N A x, IsMaximalSidon N A → 1 ≤ x → x ≤ N → x ∉ A → (∃ a ∈ A, ∃ b ∈ A, ∃ c ∈ A, x + a = b + c) ∨ (∃ a ∈ A, ∃ b ∈ A, x + x = a + b)
lemmas.paper_notes: Foundation of the Ω(N^{1/3}) lower bound on maximal Sidon sets (Erdős–Sós–Sárközy, Problem #156): every excluded x must collide in sum with A.

lemmas.title: Erdős #156 Small-N Synthesis: construct and Lean-verify a maximal Sidon subset A ⊆ {1..30} of size at most 6
lemmas.statement: ∃ A : List Nat, A.length ≤ 6 ∧ IsMaximalSidon 30 A
lemmas.registered_statement: ∃ A : List Nat, A.length ≤ 6 ∧ IsMaximalSidon 30 A
lemmas.paper_notes: Use Python/SAT search to synthesize a maximal Sidon subset of {1..30} with |A| ≤ 6 (note greedy gives size 7: {1,2,4,8,13,21,31}!), then verify IsMaximalSidon 30 A in Lean 4!
